Across these frames, the viewpoint shifts rightward along the display and slightly back, moving the green apples from left toward center and revealing more yellow fruit and rear baskets. In frame 4, the camera turns sharply right away from the produce toward an open doorway or aisle, where a man stands about 1–1.5 m ahead and slightly right, facing and apparently looking toward the camera wearer. By frame 5, the man is closer at roughly 0.6–1 m and is partly cut off by the right edge, while the produce has moved almost entirely out of view and the doorway, wall, and overhead structure occupy the center and left.
